paite: TOUPA aw, nang ka Pathian na hi a; ka hon pahtawi ding, na min ka phat ding; thillamdangtak, nidanglai a vaihawmte, ginomtak leh thutak in na hih ngal a.
heading: Phatna La
english: Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

paite: Khopite leivum in na suaksak a; akulhte uh leng na hihsia hi; gamdang mite kumpipa' inn leng khopi hi nawn lou in na bawl ngal a; chikchiang mah a lam in a-om nawnta kei ding.
english: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.

paite: Huaiziak in mihat mahmahte'n ahon pahtawi ding ua, nam kihtakhuai mahmah khopi in ahon kihta ding uhi.
english: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.

paite: Mikihtakhuaite hu huihpi in baang asawn ok-ok lai bang a ahong om chiang in, nang zaw migenthei a ding in bukna, tagah mangbang lai a ding in bukna, huihpi lak a kihumbitna, nisa liahna na hi ngal a.
english: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

paite: Mun keu a kholum na daihsak zel bang in, gamdang mite husa na daisak hi; kholum meiliah a daihsak a a-om bang in, milauhuaite thawm daihsak ahi ding.
english: As the heat in a dry place will you bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.

paite: Huan hiai tang ah sepaihte' TOUPA'N michih a ding in thil thaute, uain todat toh kidiah, thil thau mahmah guhngek a dim, uain todat toh kidiah hoihtak a khitsiang in ankuang alui ding hi.
heading: Pathian In Ankuangluina Abawl
english: In this mountain, Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of fat things, a feast of choice wines, of fat things full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.

paite: Huan khuhna mi tengteng tung a khiak, puanzak nam chih tung a kizak, hiai tang ah ahihse ding hi.
english: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

paite: Sihna avalh denta, Toupa PATHIAN in mi tengteng mai a kipan khitui anulsiang ding a; amite minsiatna lah leitung luah tengteng a kipan in alamang ding; TOUPA'N huai achita hi.
english: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for Yahweh has spoken it.

paite: Huai ni in, “Ngai un, hiai i Pathian ahi; amah i ngakngak ua, huchi in ahon hondam ding; hiai TOUPA ahi; amah i ngakngak ua; ahotdamna ah i kipak in i nuam ding uh," achi ding uhi.
english: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is Yahweh! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”

paite: Hiai tang ah TOUPA khut a kinga ding a, Moab, buhpawl ek kua a sikden a a-om sek bang in, amah mun ah sikden a om ding ahi ngal a.
heading: Pathian In Moab Asawi Ding
english: For in this mountain the hand of Yahweh will rest. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

paite: Huchi in tuiliaumi in liau ding a tui akhuat bang in, huai lak ah akhut azakkhe ding a; akisaktheihna lah akhut lepchiahna toh in TOUPA'N akoihniam ding.
english: He will spread out his hands in its midst, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.

paite: Huan na kulhbaangte insang kulhpi hihchim in, akoihniam a, lei ah leivui pha hial in apuksakta hi.
english: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
